questions.question: Full-stack development refers to proficiency in which of the following?
Full-stack developers have the skills to work on which layers of a web application?
options: Allowing devices to be connected and disconnected without rebooting the computer
A piece of computer hardware added to a computer in order to expand its abilities
Programs through which manufacturers responsibly collect and recycle their products
All layers, from the user interface to server-side logic and database management
questions.correctAnswer: All layers, from the user interface to server-side logic and database management

Which of the following is a server-side programming language a full-stack developer may use?
Which of the following is a database a full-stack developer works with?

Full-stack developers can create and consume what to enable communication between different software systems?

questions.question: In what ways can a full-stack developer work on a project?
options: Report it to your IT department or system administrator immediately
Through self-study, workshops, certifications, or higher education
Independently or with specialized front-end and back-end developers
Limited storage capacity, slow speed, and a problem of overheating
questions.correctAnswer: Independently or with specialized front-end and back-end developers

questions.question: Full-stack developers are capable of handling the entire development process from which point to which point?
options: Designing interfaces to implementing server-side logic
Only from database design to server maintenance
Every 2 hours, rest for 20 minutes with 20 candles lit
questions.correctAnswer: Designing interfaces to implementing server-side logic

questions.question: Which of the following best describes a full-stack developer?
options: A developer versatile in both client-side and server-side development
Back straight, feet flat on the floor and wrists in a neutral position
More flexible with input/output, smaller size, and better performance
According to local regulations to prevent environmental contamination
questions.correctAnswer: A developer versatile in both client-side and server-side development

questions.question: Which of the following is a database-related skill of a full-stack developer?
options: Writing complex queries and optimizing data retrieval and storage
Limited storage capacity, slow speed, and a problem of overheating
Donating or reselling it to extend its lifespan and reduce waste
Methods for increasing the speed of a computer before selling it
questions.correctAnswer: Writing complex queries and optimizing data retrieval and storage
